mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP) indicates economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate turns negative in the next 6 months, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than a 5-year average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 1.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 1.5% for the next 3 months, or 20-day returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in PAYEMS below 5 million persons signals tight labor markets, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS remains above 5.0e6 for the next 2 months, or 5-day returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and decline in UNRATE (tightening policy and low unemployment) creates conflicting pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS doesn't rise or UNRATE doesn't fall, or returns are not significantly negative (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly growth in GDPC1 (GDP) and HOUST (industrial production) signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST does not rise, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A peak in INDPRO followed by decline during a late-cycle expansion signals an impending slowdown, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not peak or decline as expected, or returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in CPIAUCSL above 231.0 signals accelerating inflation, pressuring equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL remains below 231.0 for the next month, or 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and decline in FEDFUNDS (tightening) creates conflicting pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Either CPIAUCSL doesn't rise or FEDFUNDS doesn't fall, or returns are not significantly negative (p < 0.05).
